morphology.formula: ∅ + engine → engine；标准马来语对应词：enjin
morphology.pattern_note: 这里按输入中的英语整词处理；en- 不是马来语前缀。IPA 表示英语读音，is_root 沿用输入的整词分析，不表示它是本土马来语词根。

senses.zh_definition: 发动机；把能量转换为机械动力的机器。此处为英语词形，标准马来语对应 enjin。
senses.en_definition: A machine that converts energy into mechanical power.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang sepadan dengan enjin, iaitu mesin yang menukarkan tenaga kepada daya atau gerakan mekanik.
senses.nuances: 不能将 engine 标为已获证实的标准马来语词形；DBP 收录的对应词为 enjin。本条马来语释义是对应义说明，并非 DBP 对 engine 的独立词条释义；搭配保留英语形式。[DBP：enjin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=enjin)

dual_scenarios.en: The English term “engine” in the report refers to the vehicle's engine.

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian conversation, an English word can appear inside an otherwise Malay sentence, especially when speakers discuss cars or technical work. Engine should therefore be distinguished from enjin, the spelling recorded in Malay dictionaries. This entry documents that language boundary; the packet supplies no evidence for dating the borrowing or reconstructing its earliest local use.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: engine 与 enjin 意义相接：看到英语 engine，写标准马来语时想到 enjin；词首不是可拆的马来语前缀。
